translations.web: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
translations.bsb: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
